candidates.description: req.body.id is passed directly to MongoDB _id queries without type validation, allowing operator objects like {"$ne":null} to match and modify arbitrary reviews.
candidates.rationale: Line 18 reads id from req.body without type check. Lines 25,35,50 use it as _id in findOne/update. Route is authenticated (server.ts:654 security.isAuthorized) but NoSQL operators bypass the intended single-document scope. Verification: send {"id":{"$ne":null}} as authenticated user and observe likesCount increment on multiple reviews.
candidates.title: NoSQL operator injection via unvalidated id in likeProductReviews
